purpose: Review a finite issuer foreign-exchange, interest-rate, commodity-price and derivative-hedging disclosure domain before opening source rows, filing text, exposure or hedge values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.supply_chain_boundary: Campaign163 freezes supplier and logistics disclosure states. A purchase or supply contract does not establish commodity-price exposure, hedge designation, notional, maturity, effectiveness or settlement.
repository_evidence.commercial_terms_boundary: Campaign169 freezes customer and regulated pricing terms. Product price changes or pass-through clauses do not establish treasury exposure measurement or hedge coverage.
repository_evidence.insurance_boundary: Campaign172 freezes insurance and retained-loss source admission. Insurance transfers event loss; derivatives and natural hedges manage market-price, rate or currency exposure and require different identities and timing.
repository_evidence.tax_boundary: Campaign173 freezes issuer tax-position source admission. Derivative tax treatment or withholding does not establish the underlying exposure, hedge designation or effectiveness state.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current annual-report sensitivity table or derivative note cannot be projected backward without trade, exposure, designation, maturity, settlement, discontinuation, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact issuer filing, exchange announcement, trade repository, clearing, bank confirmation or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable observation identity
first-public timestamp, trading-session availability, exposure measurement date, trade date, designation date, effective date, maturity, termination, settlement, correction and supersession chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, branch, project, asset, liability, forecast transaction, firm commitment and counterparty mapping without current-state leakage
risk taxonomy separating transactional and translational foreign exchange, interest-rate repricing, commodity input/output price, equity, credit and other market risks
currency pair, benchmark rate, commodity grade, location, unit, tenor, quantity, notional, gross versus net exposure and natural-hedge semantics
instrument identity separating forwards, futures, swaps, options, collars, caps, floors, cross-currency swaps, embedded derivatives and non-derivative natural hedges
accounting designation separating cash-flow, fair-value and net-investment hedges from economic hedges, trading derivatives and undesignated positions
hedged item, hedging instrument, hedge ratio, effectiveness method, ineffectiveness, OCI, profit-or-loss recycling and discontinuation semantics
collateral, margin, liquidity, counterparty, netting, close-out, rollover, early termination and cash-settlement timing
missing, undisclosed, confidential, not-applicable, expired, terminated, true zero exposure, zero notional and zero hedge semantics without favorable absence coding
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer and counterparty identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser, identity, timing, unit, exposure-instrument linkage, designation, effectiveness and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: foreign_currency_transaction_translation_and_hedge_coverage_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer foreign-currency exposure and its derivative or natural-hedge coverage state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted history freezes currency pair, transactional versus translational exposure, gross/net and natural-hedge basis, instrument and counterparty identity, notional, tenor, designation, maturity, settlement, first availability and complete 2019-2023 issuer coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: interest_rate_repricing_duration_and_hedge_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer fixed/floating-rate exposure, repricing profile and cap, floor or swap hedge state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Debt, deposit, lease and derivative notionals, benchmark and spread, repricing bucket, duration, embedded option, netting, collateral, hedge designation, effectiveness and point-in-time revision histories are not frozen in one accepted source contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: commodity_input_output_price_exposure_and_hedge_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer commodity input or output price exposure and its futures, option, swap or contractual natural-hedge state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Commodity grade, geography, physical quantity, purchase/sale commitment, inventory, basis risk, unit conversion, hedge instrument, notional, maturity, rollover and first-public histories are absent from a complete cross-issuer contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: derivative_designation_effectiveness_ineffectiveness_and_discontinuation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer hedge-accounting designation, effectiveness, ineffectiveness, recycling, termination or discontinuation state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete point-in-time link among hedged item, instrument, designation, prospective/retrospective effectiveness, OCI and profit-or-loss amounts, recycling, forecast-transaction realization, termination and correction timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: security_price_volatility_debt_contract_supply_contract_or_insurance_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing security-price, accounting, debt, commercial-contract, supply-chain or insurance state relabeled as enterprise market-risk hedging.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Historical security volatility, debt terms, supplier contracts, pricing pass-through and insurance do not identify treasury exposure, hedge instrument, designation, hedge ratio, maturity or effectiveness; renaming them would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: hedge_coverage_sensitivity_notional_effectiveness_direction_or_window_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transform of an issuer exposure, derivative notional, sensitivity, hedge ratio, effectiveness or maturity against assets, revenue, costs, debt, equity or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher or lower hedge coverage, raw versus net notional, sensitivity shock, accounting versus economic hedge, risk-class subset, maturity window or peer benchmark before source admission would multiply hypotheses; more hedging can signal resilience or greater underlying exposure.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_currency_rate_commodity_derivative_gap_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across foreign-exchange, interest-rate, commodity-price and hedge-effectiveness families.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or selecting weights, gaps, ranks, sensitivities, interactions, filters or models would expand the search before any component has a complete source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct enterprise market-risk and hedging states remain deferred at source admission; security-price, accounting, contract, supply-chain or insurance relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven scientific decisions and the timestamp-format infrastructure failure in the Campaign174 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
